description: Points a domain and its www at a business website built and hosted by Heropages on Vercel. Email and every other record stay as they are.
variableDescription: ip: the Vercel address for the domain itself (Vercel gives each project its own); target: the Vercel name www points to; verify: Vercel's ownership value after vc-domain-verify=, when the domain is in another Vercel account
